name: Mascot Locker Room
read_aloud: Mascot Locker Room. Costume station empty; crowd audio active. This zone covers the dying lesson. Absorb what you need.
narrator_line: Mascot Locker Room. Costume station empty; crowd audio active.
layout: A foam-smelling locker room: rows of lockers, benches, a cracked mirror wall, a giant mascot costume hanging from a hook in the middle.

exits.name: Doorway back to the Break Room.
Doorway on to the Green Room (Z9).

features.name: Benches and locker banks (half cover); the mirror wall gives no cover.
Searching lockers is loud: a Ceiling Ticks roll after a few banks (00-overview.md section 5.8).
Reflections in the cracked mirror are slightly late (flavor, no mechanics).

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.
spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: A foam-smelling locker room, a mascot suit on a hook, and a service key somewhere inside it.
quick_run.decision: Fight the animated armor head-on, or use the room (lockers, mirror, noise) against it?
quick_run.on_success: The costume falls and the service key is theirs.
quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler drops and the party must spend a short-rest slot or retreat.
quick_run.cut_short: Drop the locker-search noise and run the fight as armor plus blades only.

loot.text: Bruiser's service key (opens the Zone S door).
Bruiser's head also holds a Potion of Healing, the third placed potion (Sports Drink, Green Flavor per overview).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
